newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ECI Telecom up in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ECI Telecom up in New York.

text.p: ECI Telecom Ltd rose in New York Monday along with other Israeli stocks, boosted by prospects for an Israeli-Palestinian accord on the West Bank town of Hebron.
"It seems like they are all trading up. The whole Israeli market both here and abroad is trading up," one trader said.
Signs increased Monday that agreement on an Israeli withdrawal from Hebron was near. The matter has been a focus of tension between the two sides for months.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) of ECI Telecom rose 1-1/16 to 23-7/16 in heavy trade.
ECI was among the most actively traded ADRs.
It was also helped by initiation of coverage by SoundView Financial analyst Chandan Sarkar, who rated the stock as a short- and long-term buy.
Among other Israeli stocks, Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Inc rose 1/4 to 52-1/2.

Most ADRs followed the Dow Jones Industrial Average moderately higher. Among Japanese shares, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd was up 2-5/8 to 155-3/8, reflecting an overnight rebound in the Nikkei 225 average and news that the company would buy back 50 million shares.
The New York Stock Exchange's country basket of Japanese stocks rose 2-3/8 to 30-3/8.
Advancers led decliners by a margin of 297 to 178 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 27.9 million ADRs in late morning.
